name: Alternatingcaseshift

description_json.name: AlternatingCaseShift
description_json.idea: A simple, highly deterministic character-by-character substitution cipher designed to be extremely easy for LLMs to reason about. It shifts uppercase letters forward by 3 positions in the alphabet (A->D, B->E, ..., Z->C) and lowercase letters backward by 3 positions (a->x, b->y, ..., z->w). Numbers, spaces, and punctuation marks remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it forward by 3 positions: encrypt(char) = (char - 'A' + 3) % 26 + 'A'.
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it backward by 3 positions: encrypt(char) = (char - 'a' - 3) % 26 + 'a'.
3. If it is any other character (digits, spaces, punctuation), leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it backward by 3 positions: decrypt(char) = (char - 'A' - 3) % 26 + 'A'.
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it forward by 3 positions: decrypt(char) = (char - 'a' + 3) % 26 + 'a'.
3. If it is any other character (digits, spaces, punctuation), leave it unchanged.
